blocks.heading: Protecting cellular-connected IoT and mobile endpoints is costly and complex

blocks.text: Securing billions of cellular-connected IoT and mobile devices is a growing challenge. Traditional solutions like VPNs and firewalls can't scale to meet today's needs, resulting in poor visibility, complex remote access, increased security risks, and soaring costs. Connectivity gaps and latency across global networks disrupt performance, and managing multiple contracts adds operational strain.
As the connected IoT market grows worldwide in the coming years, these issues will only become more critical.

blocks.heading: A unified zero trust service for all cellular connected devices

blocks.text: Zscaler Cellular delivers secure, scalable, and efficient connectivity as a service for cellular-connected IoT and mobile devices. Powered by the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™ platform, it enforces granular policies, ensures centralized visibility, and eliminates attack surfaces for cellular traffic. Through seamless integration with your existing telecom infrastructure, it simplifies management while enabling global connectivity over any protocol.
Zscaler Cellular provides unified control over cellular traffic for superior, secure operations and scalable connectivity in any environment.
Ensure individual device segmentation, least-privilege access, and complete visibility.
Enable a SIM, and Zscaler Cellular is ready to go, with no complex deployment.
Maintain global coverage with optimized egress and multi-operator support.
Take advantage of streamlined provisioning with minimal changes to your telecom infrastructure.
Monitor telemetry metrics from a centralized view, including SIM activity and anomaly detection.
Eliminate the need for software agents on IoT and mobile endpoints, regardless of device type.
Prevent lateral movement in your network by enforcing dynamic zero trust policies.

blocks.heading: The leading zero trust, now for mobile and IoT

blocks.text: Zscaler Cellular uses the Zero Trust Exchange to deliver streamlined provisioning, intelligent traffic management, and zero trust policy enforcement, ensuring secure and efficient connectivity for cellular-connected IoT and mobile devices.
The service is available in two key deployment options to suit any ecosystem:

Plug-and-play agentless security for cellular IoT devices like vending machines, EV chargers, and kiosks securely forwards traffic to the Zscaler platform for inspection, granular policy enforcement, and anomaly detection with detailed telemetry.

Our partner-managed solution securely forwards IoT cellular traffic via SIM infrastructure to the Zscaler platform for inspection, policy enforcement, and analytics with high availability and failover.
Leverage cloud-delivered security to protect cellular devices with visibility, anomaly detection, and advanced DNS, SWG, FW, and ZTNA controls.
Reduce costs and complexity with direct-to-cloud routing, global coverage, and simplified segmentation—no circuits, VPNs, or legacy firewalls required.
Ensure uniform connectivity with global coverage, resilient networks, low latency, and rapid over-the-air updates via advanced SIM technology.
